name: Gym Diary
longDescription: Gym Diary is a comprehensive workout tracking app designed to help fitness enthusiasts log their workouts, track progress, and stay motivated. With an intuitive interface and powerful features, it makes tracking your fitness journey effortless.

name: Expense Diary
description: App to track your budgets and expenses.
longDescription: Expense Diary is a personal finance management app that helps users track their spending, manage budgets, and gain insights into their financial habits. Simple yet powerful tools for better financial health.
highlights: Featured in App Store's 'New Apps We Love'

name: Easy Fast - Intermittent Fasting
longDescription: Easy Fast is an intermittent fasting companion that helps users maintain their fasting schedules with timers, progress tracking, and motivational features. Designed to make intermittent fasting simple and sustainable.

name: Five Task
description: Yet another To Do app. I promise its better
longDescription: Five Task is a minimalist productivity app based on the principle of focusing on just five important tasks per day. Clean design meets powerful functionality to help users stay focused and productive.

name: Timo - Interval Timer
longDescription: Interval timer app for workouts, meditation and more.

name: Money Savings Goal Tracker
description: App to track your savings goals
longDescription: Money Savings Goal Tracker is a simple and effective app that helps users set, track, and achieve their savings goals. With an intuitive interface and useful features, it makes saving money easier and more motivating.
highlights: Coming soon to the App Store

name: My Subs - Subscription Tracker
longDescription: My Subs keeps every subscription and recurring bill in one place, so you always know what's renewing, when, and how much it costs. Add a subscription - streaming, gym, cloud storage, anything you're billed for - and My Subs tracks upcoming renewals, free-trial end dates, and your full charge history, all in one clean overview.
features: Renewal reminders timed to your billing period
Separate trial-end alerts before you're charged
Spend at a glance: weekly, monthly & yearly totals with trend charts
Full charge history per subscription, with backfill support
Color-coded categories and avatars to stay organized
iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad
highlights: No subscriptions, no ads - free up to 3 subscriptions, with a one-time Pro unlock
